notify.linked_ok: ✅ Telegram linked to TopStocks ({email}). You'll receive your digests and alerts here.
notify.test_message: 👋 Test message from TopStocks — notifications are working.
notify.tg_linked: ✅ Telegram linked to TopStocks. Digests, alerts — and you can chat with the assistant right here. Send /help to see what it can do.
notify.chat_not_linked: This Telegram account isn't linked to TopStocks yet. Open the app → Profile → Notifications → Connect Telegram.
notify.link_failed: That link code is invalid or expired — generate a new one from the Profile page and tap the link again.
notify.chat_help: Ask me anything about your portfolio or the markets — same assistant as the app's chat panel, same conversation thread. Replies can take a minute. Commands: /clear resets the conversation, /help shows this.
notify.chat_cleared: 🧹 Conversation cleared — same thread as the app, so it's cleared there too.
notify.chat_error: Something went wrong answering that — please try again in a moment.
